finding_key: packages/docs/src/model/document.ts::only `togglelist` exits through `unlistedblocktype`; the other two list-exit gestures still hardcode `'paragraph'`, so the same user intent gives two different results
evidence: Verified in packages/docs/src/model/document.ts: deleteBackward (empty list-item branch) and splitBlock (empty list-item branch) both call setBlockType(id, 'paragraph') unchanged, and setBlockType for 'paragraph' deletes headingLevel in both stores per the diff. So these list-exit gestures drop the retained heading level while toggleList restores it — the inconsistency is real and not covered by the todo's non-goal, which concerns the new block created by a mid-text split. Impact is limited to empty list items (no visible text lost), so this is a consistency/design gap rather than serious data loss.
